name: lpk-mod
description: Early-access extras for lpk: /lpk-status (a pane with the lpk run's steps, slices, gates, team and findings), /lpk-switch (the state card and the account for the next claude start), /lpk-waive, /lpk-fleet, /lpk-view, /lpk-spawn and `@name text` (the sessions working in the repo: a pane, a tab to watch one, one to start, a message to one), a memory and quota hint before a fan-out, and compaction that keeps an lpk run's state. lpk works without it.

lpkRoot.title: lpk plugin folder
lpkRoot.description: The folder holding lpk's bin/lpk. Empty: the installed lpk plugin.

spawnArgs.title: Extra claude arguments for /lpk-spawn
spawnArgs.description: Added to `claude --bg` when /lpk-spawn starts a session, for example --permission-mode bypassPermissions. Empty: the session asks for permissions as claude does by default.

memoryFloorGb.title: Memory floor (GB)
memoryFloorGb.description: Below this much available memory, a second agent at once draws a hint to run the parts one at a time. lpk's own field of this name wins when it has one.

quotaFloorPercent.title: Quota floor (% left)
quotaFloorPercent.description: Below this share of a rate-limit window left, a new agent draws a hint. lpk's own field of this name wins when it has one.
